metadata.title: A counterexample to the local existence of conformal normal metrics
metadata.abstract: For every dimension $n\ge3$, we construct a smooth Riemannian metric whose entire Taylor series at a point agrees with the Euclidean metric and whose conformal class contains no smooth conformal normal metric near that point. For the metric used in the construction, parametrized by a smooth angular function, we prove that conformal normalization forces a dimension-dependent exponential decay rate for the spherical harmonic components of that function. This gives counterexamples whenever the angular coefficients decay too slowly. In particular, every nonanalytic angular function yields a counterexample. The proof combines a weighted cylinder estimate with an integral identity relating the angular spectral coefficients of the background volume defect to the nonlinear remainder. We also give a direct counterexample to the linear right inverse used in Cao's smooth existence argument and identify the failure of angular summability in that construction.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 对每个 n≥3 构造一点处所有 Taylor 系数都与欧氏度量一致的光滑度量，但其共形类在该点附近没有光滑共形正规度量。
techniques: 非线性余项积分恒等式
analysis.breakthrough: 揭示无限阶形式正规化并不保证实际光滑局部解，并指出既有线性右逆论证中的角向可和性问题。
analysis.limitations: 反例属于特定角函数参数族；不能据此否定有限阶共形正规化或实解析结果。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
